rows.grounds: compound expressing successive order from what precedes

items.question: What general designation and sequential position are assigned to the kukkuṭa method?
premises: The term kukkuṭa is introduced as a designation.
This designation is characterized as general.
Its placement follows the established preceding sequence.
items.inference: Therefore kukkuṭa is identified as the general method in due sequence.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of kukkuṭa in this ritual context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: And 'kukkuṭa' is the general designation, following in the established sequence.
